goal: Make pmcro-orchestrator's agent name pass Cowork's alphanumeric-and-hyphen-only naming rule, without weakening the file's content or the plugin's manifest contract.

steps.action: Confirm Cowork derives the agent name from the agent file's basename (minus .md), so 'orchestrator.agent.md' yields the invalid name 'orchestrator.agent'.
Rename agents/orchestrator.agent.md to agents/orchestrator.md and add an explicit 'name: orchestrator' frontmatter field as a belt-and-suspenders override.
Update both plugin.json manifests (root and .claude-plugin/) to reference the renamed file.
Rebuild pmcro-orchestrator.zip and verify the new entry name and byte size.
Confirm no other live (non-sealed-trail) reference to the old dotted filename remains.

success_criteria: Rebuilt zip contains agents/orchestrator.md with forward-slash paths
No live doc or manifest still points at the old orchestrator.agent.md name (sealed trail history is exempt — it's an immutable log, not a live reference)
out_of_scope: Renaming the command/run/reject asset triad's dotted filenames (not flagged by the validator, and those are assets, not agent-name-derived)
The org-level Cowork plugin sync issue
